name: light-speed
title: Light Speed
description: A night drive rendered in 3D: glowing car lights and lane markers stream toward the viewer and bend with the road. Holding the pointer speeds them up.
use: A hero or splash wants a fast, atmospheric night-drive mood that reacts to a press.
avoid: A heavy 3D scene with bloom that needs a set height and a reasonably capable GPU.
a11y: Speed-up is hold-only and the WebGL scene has no label or keyboard path; reduced-motion is ignored. (keyboard: no, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A black sky tops a dark road where dozens of neon streaks converge to a vanishing point. The left lanes glow magenta and purple, the right lanes teal and blue, and a white instruction line floats over the middle.
behaves: The light trails stream toward the camera continuously, sweeping as the road bends. Pressing and holding the pointer accelerates the rush, then it eases back on release.
customise: A single effectOptions object sets road width, lanes, length, field of view, speed-up and light counts; the shaders and layout are fixed.
weight: heavy: A Three.js highway with instanced lights and bloom rendered every frame.
